purpose: The shape every BM-06 case must have before any arm runs. Frozen by PROTOCOL.md; the case array itself is NOT yet populated (PROTOCOL.md section 7).

manifest.protocol_sha256: sha256 of PROTOCOL.md at freeze time; a protocol edit invalidates every run made under the old one
manifest.manifest_hash: sha256 of the canonical case array plus arms plus model config; results.json is stamped with it and a report refuses to print against a different hash

model.id: frozen model id, identical across arms A, B and C

budget.scope: one frozen authorization scope for the whole run (DAR-005)
budget.max_usd: the authorized ceiling; a refusal abstains the task rather than proceeding
budget.worst_case_usd: computed from reserve_cost at the frozen caps, not from past averages

arms.A: the model alone; accept if the target test passes after applying the patch
arms.B: model + ledger + random probe selection; the same counterfactual gate as C
arms.C: the full kernel; accept only on verified_against_approved_checks

case.parent: commit at which the target fails — the state every arm starts from
case.commit: the project's own fix; ground truth for a correct repair
case.target: pytest node id that fails at parent
case.label: gateable | observationally_diagnosable | neither — assigned by review BEFORE any arm runs (BM-01)
case.cause_class: state_leakage | order_dependence | missing_dependency | version_mismatch | locale_timezone | nondeterminism | two_cause | genuine_source_bug

ground_truth.source_files: files the project's own fix touched
ground_truth.rationale: why this label is correct, in a sentence a reviewer can check

adversarial_review.structurally_unsatisfiable: boolean — a contradiction inside one assertion does NOT qualify; it must be expressible only across a change check and a frozen preservation check
adversarial_review.note: the specific pathological satisfaction that was ruled out

case.preserve: pytest node ids that must pass on both sides of the patch
case.invalidation: required when status is not OK; disclosed by name in the report, excluded from scoring, spend reported separately (DAR-003)

result.manifest_hash: must match the manifest the run was built from
result.verdict: the scoped verdict, verbatim from the receipt
result.accepted: boolean — did this arm accept a patch
result.ground_truth_correct: boolean — was the accepted patch actually correct
result.failed_phase: the gate phase that rejected it, when one did. This is what tells us whether candidate behavioural failure is costing arm C real yield, and therefore whether the DAR-010 repair loop is justified
result.tokens: provider-reported, or the string unknown — never estimated
result.spend_event_ids: references into .rift/spend.jsonl; the figure is derived by joining, never copied
